about: Terms no tracked text file, and no tracked PDF's printed text, may contain (scripts/check-banned-terms.mjs, in verify through tests/banned-terms.test.js). CAD file import and CAD formats are fine here. Each entry is the first 24 hex digits of SHA-256 of 'margo-banned:' + the lowercased term, so this file never names them. 'tokens' match whole words (as written, with hyphens removed, and each piece of a hyphenated compound); 'pairs' match two adjacent pieces of an 'a/b/c' path. 'pathTokens' match, like 'tokens', a whole piece of a tracked file's path (split at every character that is not a letter or digit, and between camelCase words), so a file or folder name cannot bring a removed name back either. 'allow' lists { path, reason } entries; it is empty on purpose, bar one entry that waits for a ruling.

allow.reason: The goal line of the design history still names the game it was modelled on; its rewording is Scott's ruling (voxel finish plan, decision 4), then this entry goes.
